query_analysis.original_query: Our PSA system is showing inefficient cycling due to delays in valve actuation. What control upgrades would you recommend to optimize adsorption/desorption timing?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Recommend control system upgrades to minimize valve actuation delays and optimize adsorption/desorption timing in a Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) system.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Control system design and performance analysis

clarification_questions: What type of valves are currently used in the PSA system?
What is the current cycle time and what is the target cycle time?
Are there any specific constraints on the control system upgrade?
